svg.aria-label: A worksheet with blank lines. Build a major third: lower note, upper note, letters, semitones. Build a minor third: the same four blanks. Three changes from C4 + E4: upper voice up 1 (worked example: C4 + F4, perfect fourth, 4 letters, 5 semitones), lower voice down 1 (blank), lower voice up 2 (blank).
svg.title: Your keyboard sheet: build, then change

g.text: Do this on your own keyboard. Nothing here is
How to read this graphic: Work on your own
keyboard and write what you find on the
lines. The first change row is already filled
in as an example with its colour bar. The
printed version carries the same words and
lines in black and white; there is no check
